shortDescription: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. appears to be continuing to load liquefied natural gas onto tankers in the Persian Gulf despite a recent escalation of hostilities, according to satellite images and Bloomberg reported.The activity comes as risks around the Strait of Hormuz remain elevated.
